summary.text: A son of Thyestes by a Naiad nymph, murdered by Atreus at the altar of Zeus and served to his father at a banquet.

story.text: To exact his terrible revenge upon his brother Thyestes for seducing his wife Aerope, Atreus feigned a reconciliation. He slaughtered Thyestes' sons—Aglaus, Callileon, and Orchomenus—though they had taken refuge as suppliants at the altar of Zeus, boiled their flesh, and served it to Thyestes at a banquet.
